## Change and reason

Explain what was added or corrected, its practical benefit, and relevant alternatives.

## Evidence

- Primary source and check date:
- Version and release source, or explicitly unknown/not applicable:
- OS, architecture, Resolve version and Free/Studio requirements:
- Price, license and external service requirements:
- First-hand experience and limitations, or Not tested:
- Creator/vendor affiliation, or None:

## Checks

- [ ] I edited the maintained source data and regenerated affected views.
- [ ] I preserved source attribution, uncertainty and compatibility caveats.
- [ ] I checked for duplicate entries and did not infer quality from stars or inactivity.
- [ ] No installers, private information, raw research or local reports are included.
- [ ] The documented validation command passes, or I explained why it could not run.
